Name: Boolean algebra
Basic relationship:
Venn diagrams using set using only 0 and 1
Completent of a variable A is inverse
Literal: true form A, complementary form -A
Product/Implicant: (-A)B, A(-B)(-C)
Sum: A+B
Minterm: product involving all inputs A(-B)(-C)
Maxterm: sum involving all inputs A+(-B)+C
Precedence order: NOT, AND, OR
X: illegal value in circuit, don't care in truth table, sometimes due to contention
Z: floating, high-impedance, 0 or 1 or between, does not mean circuit error, so long as other circuit element drive the node to valid logic level, commonly forgetting to connect a voltage to circuit input/assume unconnected input as 0, does not cause contention with other wires
